column1: # GB5 single-core results, one row per workload per run.  Append-only; never edit a
# recorded row.  `date` is the run date, `rtl` the commit the BITSTREAM was built from.
# Why this file exists: a GB5 result page shows `model` and nothing else about the
# hardware, and two runs of the SAME commit differ 7.4% on AES-XTS (95aff227: 814.5 vs
# 754.4 kB/s).  Without the commit and the spread written down, "is this better?" is not
# answerable.  The model string now carries the commit automatically (1497f89b).
# score is GB5's integer subscore; rate is its throughput figure, which is the sensitive
# one -- a score of 1 spans a wide range of rates, so ALWAYS compare rate, not score.
# unit is the rate's unit as GB5 prints it.
